2. Check raw HTML for @media rules or linked external <link rel="stylesheet">.
If the viewport meta tag is missing:
- Add a viewport meta tag (<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">) to the <head> section.
If the viewport meta tag is missing width=device-width:
- Update the existing viewport tag to include width=device-width to ensure proper scaling on mobile devices.
If no media queries are detected:
- Implement responsive design using CSS @media queries to ensure the layout adapts to various screen sizes.
